1.

Product Overview

A complete dock solution — doors, shelters, seals, levelers and safety equipment working as one system.

Loading Bay Door systems are designed to provide safe, efficient and weather-protected access between warehouses, loading docks and transport vehicles.

A complete loading bay solution can include Sectional Overhead Doors, High Speed Doors, Dock Shelters, Dock Seals, Dock Levelers and related safety equipment.

These systems help improve loading and unloading efficiency, reduce exposure to external weather conditions, minimize air and dust transfer, and provide safer movement of goods between vehicles and warehouse facilities.

Loading Bay Doors can be customized according to the building structure, vehicle dimensions, opening size, operating frequency, environmental conditions and application requirements.

Weather Protection

Shields the dock from rain, wind, dust and outside air.

Dock Efficiency

Faster, smoother loading and unloading cycles.

Complete System

Doors, shelters, seals, levelers and safety equipment.

Custom Engineered

Built around your opening, vehicles and operating frequency.

2.

Door & Dock Equipment Types

Six core components that make up a complete, weather-sealed loading bay.

01

Sectional Overhead Doors

Insulated industrial doors for loading bays, warehouses and manufacturing facilities. The door opens vertically along overhead tracks, allowing vehicles and material handling equipment to operate efficiently around the loading area.· Insulated construction
· Vertical opening operation
· Space-efficient design
· Suitable for frequent use
· Improved thermal separation
· Manual or automatic configurations

→
02

High Speed Loading Bay Doors

Designed for loading areas where fast opening and closing is required. Rapid operation reduces waiting time, improves traffic flow and minimizes unwanted air exchange between indoor and outdoor areas.· Fast opening and closing
· Suitable for high-traffic areas
· Reduced air exchange
· Improved workflow
· Automatic operation
· Safety sensor integration

→
03

Dock Shelter

Provides a flexible enclosure between the loading dock and the rear of the vehicle, protecting the loading area from rain, wind, dust and outside air while goods are being transferred.· Weather protection
· Reduced air leakage
· Improved loading environment
· Better temperature control
· Suits different vehicle sizes
· Flexible side and top curtains

→
04

Dock Seal

Creates a close seal around the rear of a vehicle positioned at the loading dock, minimizing gaps between the vehicle and building opening for added protection against weather and air infiltration.· Warehouses
· Distribution centres
· Cold storage facilities
· Food processing facilities
· Pharmaceutical facilities
· Logistics centres

→
05

Dock Leveler

Bridges the height difference between the warehouse floor and the vehicle bed, creating a smooth transition for forklifts, pallet trucks and other material handling equipment.· Smooth vehicle-to-dock transition
· Improved forklift movement
· Increased loading efficiency
· Safer material handling
· Mechanical or powered configurations
· Suits different vehicle heights

→
06

Dock Ramp / Loading Platform

Provides access between the warehouse and vehicles where a permanent dock leveler is not suitable. Designed according to site conditions and operational requirements.· Warehouses
· Distribution centres
· Logistics facilities
· Industrial plants
· Commercial loading areas

→

6.

Installation Process

From site survey to handover — eight structured stages.

01

Site Survey

Site evaluation and measurement to understand the loading bay opening, dock height, headroom, side clearance, vehicle dimensions and existing structure.

02

System Selection

The appropriate combination of door, dock shelter, dock seal, dock leveler and safety equipment is selected according to the application.

03

Engineering & Design

Detailed dimensions, fixing arrangements, electrical requirements and operating configuration are finalized according to project requirements.

04

Manufacturing

The selected door and dock components are manufactured using suitable materials and project-approved specifications.

05

Installation

The door, frame, dock equipment, controls, seals and safety devices are professionally installed at the site.

06

Alignment & Adjustment

Door alignment, dock equipment positioning, sealing and operating mechanisms are checked and adjusted for smooth operation.

07

Testing & Commissioning

The complete system is tested for door movement, dock leveler operation, safety devices, sensors and controls.

08

Handover

Operating instructions, safety information and maintenance recommendations are provided to the customer.

7.

Maintenance Guidelines

Recommended preventive maintenance every 6 months.

Inspect door panels and frames regularly.

Check tracks, rollers, hinges and moving components.

Inspect dock shelter curtains for damage or wear.

Check dock seals for proper compression and sealing.

Inspect dock leveler platform and hinges.

Check hydraulic or mechanical components where applicable.

Inspect electrical connections and control panels.

Test photocells, safety edges and emergency stop systems.

Check warning lights and traffic signals.

Inspect dock bumpers for wear.

Check vehicle restraint systems where installed.

Keep the loading bay area clean and free from obstructions.

Check door alignment and smooth operation.

Tighten loose bolts, screws and fittings.

Lubricate applicable moving components.

Maintain service records for preventive maintenance.

Ensure proper operation of automatic systems.

Recommended preventive maintenance every 6 months.
